cpu_tests.full_command: rtk proxy python -m unittest discover -s tests -q
cpu_tests.scope: CPU contracts, owned subprocess and real loopback using explicitly fake model/event/resource fixtures. No actual model/CUDA/OOM evidence.

independent_review.scope: Independent source correctness/parsimony/product and security reviews; historical findings retained with dispositions. No actual remote qualification.

jev.disposition: Advisory concerns retained. Typed probabilities are not defect proof or approval; independent prose review found no remaining must-fix and deterministic source tests passed.
jev.limitations: No prose findings, security/release certification or actual CUDA evidence. Existing authenticated tool used; billing charges not independently verified.

graft.limitations: Source graph freshness and actual source diff impact only; not an isolated execution sandbox, correctness verifier or runtime qualification.

remaining_gate: Independent actual free remote execution and evidence review for sequential bilingual model outcomes, active CUDA cancellation, deadlines, allocator budget exhaustion and worker recovery; native/production remain separate.
